svg.title: KS-27 animated top view
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping top view of KS-27 (Lead hidden in a ramp curve while accelerating to the set speed) from its esmini replay at the parameter defaults, 4.1 to 12.3 s: A stopped lead hidden by a wall in a 250 m ramp curve while the ego accelerates. Plot: gap to the lead, bumper to bumper (m). Events: ego enters the 250 m arc, accelerating to the set speed at 5.0 s; lead comes out from behind the wall, 60 m ahead (bumper to bumper) at 10.1 s; loop ends before contact at 12.3 s. Layer 2 fixes the road and the other road users. The ego only holds its start speed here; the item under test drives it in layer 1 and on the bench, so the loop ends before the bodies overlap. Cars: Kenney Racing Pack (CC0).
